visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long, wavy dark hair and a warm smile stands before a plain white door. He is dressed in a distinctive tri-colored corduroy button-up shirt featuring shades of mustard yellow, dark green, and brown. He holds a large, bright yellow shopping bag with "Acqua di Parma" printed on it, clutching it to his chest with both hands while orange text overlays appear at the top. (2) The camera cuts to a young woman with long brown hair and bangs, seated at her office desk wearing a white graphic t-shirt. She receives the yellow bag, placing it over a blue travel neck pillow on her lap. In the background, an office setting is visible with another individual in a black baseball cap working at a computer station under bright indoor lighting. (3) The woman reaches into the bag, removing white bubble wrap to reveal a vibrant yellow Winnie the Pooh plush toy wearing a matching yellow sweater. She lifts the toy out with a look of joy and surprise while the man, now back on screen, claps his hands enthusiastically. The background remains the office interior with desks, computer monitors, and personal items.
